deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 3 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Oem Defined\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 3` output filtered to the `Oem Defined` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; finds neither a guaranteed canonical label nor an OEM semantic contract and suppresses the evidence needed to diagnose extraction failure.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly requires vendor mapping and raw preservation but misclassifies missing inputs as partial core execution.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; treats the literal query as runnable without OEM field/encoding validation.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify the OEM-defined 32-bit data in the intended SMBIOS Type 3 enclosure record matches the vendor-approved raw value and documented interpretation, if any, and remains stable after reboot without inventing semantics.
original_method: Capture the selected Type 3 record in both decoded and raw forms, locate the OEM-defined/OEM Information bytes by structure offset and applicable SMBIOS version, compare the exact raw value and only vendor-documented decode against the approved platform baseline, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user supplies and approves the vendor definition, raw expected value, target enclosure and reboot plan. Extraction and comparison are software-controlled; undocumented bytes remain uninterpreted.
required_inputs: Expected raw OEM-defined value and documented decode or explicit raw-only policy
Validated decoded/raw SMBIOS tooling and transport
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; never write OEM bytes or firmware.
Preserve full Type 3 and raw record evidence with tool/errors; literal `Oem Defined` grep is not authoritative.
Do not reverse-engineer, guess bit meanings or apply another vendor/platform's decode.
Treat zero as a valid candidate only when the vendor/project baseline allows it; distinguish unsupported from malformed/truncated data.
Stop on mapping/length/encoding ambiguity, raw drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect decoded and raw Type 3 data, bind the enclosure, extract the vendor-defined bytes at the approved offset and compare raw plus documented decoded values before/after reboot.
Do not invent OEM semantics, modify firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Provide/approve the OEM specification, encoding, expected raw value and supported-absence policy.
Resolve undocumented or inconsistent bytes and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient because decoded tools may label the field `OEM Information` or expose only a hex value, the literal phrase is not guaranteed, and grep loses raw offset/length and record provenance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the original command as provenance but archive complete Type 3 plus approved raw-record output, use the documented structure offset/length, and decode only under vendor specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The `Oem Defined` item, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the enclosure record, verify formatted length and SMBIOS version, extract the OEM-defined bytes directly, retain their exact hex value and apply only the approved vendor decoder before comparing across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 3 systems whose applicable structure length includes OEM-defined data.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, raw-parser/dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and vendor-definition revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 formatted-area layout, vendor OEM definition and installed tooling documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Avoids label-dependent grep and makes raw bytes authoritative while preventing speculative decode.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds length/offset and raw-versus-decoded consistency checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor mapping, expected raw value and structure-version applicability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Public SMBIOS documentation defines storage but not vendor meaning; absent vendor documentation, only raw capture/persistence can be reported.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a raw-only acceptance rule or supported zero/absence when vendor semantics are unavailable, but must record the exact platform, formatted length and approved rationale; this is readiness data, not permanent BLOCKED classification.
expected_evidence: Approval, vendor definition or raw-only policy, expected value, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot decoded/raw Type 3 record with offset/length and comparison
Engineer verdict with no speculative interpretation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets the Type 3 OEM-defined data. Lack of vendor semantics is an input gap, not contradictory source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw bytes can be collected safely and the test intent is understandable. Vendor mapping/expected data determine execution readiness and verdict, not automation capability.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces label-dependent grep with raw-offset evidence and refuses guessed decode.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps vendor-governed semantics and raw preservation while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines raw-only fallback, formatted-length applicability and zero/unsupported distinctions without creating a global OEM policy.

review_improvement: Prevents empty label matches, cross-platform OEM decoding and false conclusions from undocumented bytes while preserving executable raw evidence collection.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once vendor/project mapping is supplied, raw extraction, documented decode and reboot comparison are automated. Missing OEM semantics are readiness inputs under locked V3.1, not a reason for PARTIAL or permanent BLOCKED.
